input.command: git status --short --branch && git log -5 --oneline --decorate && git remote -v
git diff --check && git diff -- impl.ts artifacts/notes.md && git status --short

mkdir -p /opt/cursor/artifacts && cat > /opt/cursor/artifacts/code-tour-author-handoff.md <<'EOF'
<decision>
Implemented the rules as ordered early returns: country mismatch blocks first, then a strictly-over-$500 payment from a customer with zero prior successful payments is reviewed, and all others are allowed.

<risk>
The ticket does not prescribe reason text; reviewers should confirm the concise strings are acceptable to downstream consumers.

<verified>
Ran node smoke.ts, six assertion-based ticket and boundary checks, and git diff --check successfully.
EOF
git add impl.ts artifacts && git commit -m "Implement ticket" && git push -u origin HEAD
